criteria.criterion: The study capability's config in athena.toml (and the Config type in athena-data/src/config.rs) carries the instance's repo URL and ref; no Rust source hard-codes the firstmate URL or main outside tests/fixtures.
criteria.evidence: athena.toml adds [capabilities.study.instance] repo_url/ref. config.rs adds CapabilityConfig.instance: Option<InstanceConfig> {repo_url, git_ref (serde 'ref')}. A Grep for 'firstmate' finds it only in athena.toml, the docs and BRIEF.md, in no .rs file.

criteria.criterion: A pinning seam exists (trait with a real git-backed implementation) that resolves a URL and ref to a full 40-hex SHA and exports the tree at that SHA into a directory.
criteria.evidence: crates/athena-core/src/pin.rs defines trait Pinner {resolve, export} and GitPinner, which delegates to athena_git::resolve_ref (ls-remote, checks for a full 40-hex id, peels tags) and athena_git::export_tree (fetch --depth 1 of the sha, checkout_all, make_read_only). pin_instance also rejects any answer that is not a full SHA.

criteria.criterion: The core's job start calls the pinner only when the capability is study, before the producer runs, and records URL, ref and SHA in the job's records (record type updated as needed).
criteria.evidence: run.rs calls crate::pin::pin_instance right after the redactor and before the prediction commit. It returns None unless capability.instance() is Some, and only Study overrides instance(). The Job record gets `instance: pin.clone()` (new InstancePin {url, ref, sha} in records.rs). mount() runs after Snapshot::create and before the producer is composed.

criteria.criterion: The pinned tree is placed inside the agents' working directory with all files read-only, and the study producer/verifier grants give no write access to it.
criteria.evidence: mount() exports to snapshot_dir/pinned and excludes it via .git/info/exclude. export_tree clears 0o222 on every file and directory. Study producer_grant and verifier_grant set read_only = [PINNED_DIR], and policy.rs confine_write denies Write/Edit, rm/mv/chmod and redirection into it (test read_only_paths_refuse_writes_and_allow_reads passed).

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-core`: a test with a fake pinner asserts the study dispatch calls it once with the URL and ref from the study config (not hard-coded) and records the returned SHA.
criteria.evidence: pin::tests::a_study_job_pins_the_configured_url_and_ref_once_and_records_the_sha passed. It calls pin_instance(&FakePinner, &Stub("study"), &jc) with a test-local Stub capability (not athena-cap-study's Study) and checks the returned InstancePin. It never drives the dispatch in run.rs and never reads the job record, so it does not show that the study dispatch calls the pinner or records the SHA. Deleting the pin_instance call or the `instance: pin.clone()` field in run.rs would leave it green.

findings.evidence: The fake-pinner tests in pin.rs call the helper pin_instance with a test-local Stub capability. The call site in run.rs (pin_instance before the prediction commit, `instance: pin.clone()` in the Job record, and both mount calls) is never exercised: lifecycle tests build Athena with the real GitPinner and the fake driver defaults to the change capability. Removing the run.rs call would not fail any test. A scripted FakeAgentDriver (fake.rs supports per-invocation scripts) plus `pinner: Box::new(FakePinner)` on Athena would make a dispatch-level test possible.

findings.evidence: the_change_capability_never_calls_the_pinner uses Stub("change"), whose instance() reads the config table. It would not catch a change to Change's own instance() override.

summary: I read the whole diff and ran `cargo test -p athena-core`, `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked`. All of them pass. The implementation looks right. `[capabilities.study.instance]` holds the URL and ref (firstmate/main). `InstanceConfig` and `InstancePin` were added, and `Job.instance` records the url, ref and sha. `GitPinner` uses `git ls-remote` plus a one-commit fetch and checkout-index through athena-git. In run.rs the core pins before the prediction commit and mounts the tree at `pinned/` (write bits cleared) for both producer and verifier. The agent hook refuses writes under `pinned/`. No Rust source names firstmate, and D75 records the choice to use git rather than a crate. It fails on one point: the user asked to "test that the core calls it", and criterion 5 needs a test showing the *study dispatch* calls the pinner and records the SHA. The new tests only call the helper `pin_instance` with a stub capability that copies Study's `instance()`. They never run the dispatch in run.rs or look at the job record. If the call in run.rs were deleted, or `instance: pin.clone()` dropped from the Job record, every test would still pass. The repo has a scriptable fake agent driver and a public `pinner` field on `Athena`, so a dispatch-level test with a fake pinner is doable.
